1. DESIGN & PERSIST THEME ATTRIBUTE TOKENS SCHEMA (`src/lib/ecmdThemeEngine.ts` & theme types):
   - Add a 100% backward-compatible `designTokens` registry to the persisted Site Themes store (synced cleanly to Supabase + local fallback alongside themes & imageGroups):
     * Token categories (`type`): `"boxShadow" | "textShadow" | "paint" | "border" | "radius"` (`"paint"` covers both Solid colors and `linear`/`radial`/`conic` Gradients so a single paint token works seamlessly on `Background`, `Text`, or `Border`!).
     * Each `ThemeDesignToken` includes:
       - `id`: stable slug (e.g. `"tok-box-shadow-glass-card"`)
       - `name`: human-readable label (e.g. `"Glass Card Shadow"`, `"Heading Crisp + Glow"`, `"Emerald Luxe Gradient"`)
       - `type`: `"boxShadow" | "textShadow" | "paint" | "border" | "radius"`
       - `value`: default structured/serialized value (e.g., full multi-layer `BoxShadow` config + compiled CSS, `TextShadow` config + compiled CSS, HEX/RGBA/Gradient string, or `{ width, style, color, radius }`)
       - `themeOverrides?: Record<string, typeof value>`: optional per-theme override map keyed by `themeId` so a token can optionally adapt per theme while defaulting to `value`!
   - Extend Group state attributes (`default`, `hover`, `focus`, `selected`, `selectedHover`, `disabled`) with an optional `tokenRefs?: Partial<Record<"background" | "text" | "border" | "boxShadow" | "textShadow" | "borderRadius", string>>` map:
     * When `tokenRefs.<attr>` points to a valid `ThemeDesignToken.id`, `ecmdThemeEngine.ts` dynamically resolves that token's active value for the current theme (checking `token.themeOverrides?.[activeThemeId] ?? token.value`) when generating live Group CSS!
     * Also emit clean `:root` CSS variables (`--ecmd-tok-<slug>: <compiledCssValue>;`) for every registered token on the active theme!
     * If a token is deleted, gracefully fall back to the Group state's last resolved value and clear the stale `tokenRef` so styles NEVER break or disappear!

3. VITEST COVERAGE (`src/test/`):

     a) Saving a `boxShadow`, `textShadow`, and `paint` (gradient/solid) token, binding it via `tokenRefs` to multiple Groups, and confirming that updating the token updates the emitted CSS for all linked Groups automatically.
